transcriber_notes: Measured on the embedded chart raster (6160x2832 px, chart in its left half). Boundaries printed on the right axis (103, 90, 72, 51, 22, 13, 0) and confirmed by bar steps (23.81 px/cm). Hardness from bar left edges vs the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (708/968/1228/1488/1748/2008 px; thirds as +/-): 1836 px -> 4F-, 1920 px -> F+, 1660 px -> 4F+, 1400 px -> 1F+. Water content column blank for all layers. Temperature is a red line without point markers: break points 90, 80, 60, 40 cm plus ends 103/0 cm (0 C at x=2115 px, 46.6 px/C; the dashed air-temperature segment starts at -11.0 C = printed air temp; vertices land on whole degrees, +-0.1 C). Surface snow temperature -14.0 C (colder than air) as drawn. The two left boxes carry labels only (no test results) and were applied as interfaces; red lines assigned to the layer whose bar they are drawn in (Avanet draws them at the bottom of the layer above the named boundary).
